name: Mind Control
overview: Scripture teaches that true mind control is found not in worldly conformity but in the Spirit-led renewal of the mind, enabling believers to discern and live out God's perfect will (Romans 12:2). Jesus Himself was led by the Spirit and resisted temptation, demonstrating the power of divine guidance over the enemy's schemes (Matthew 4:1). The Holy Spirit acts as a Comforter and teacher, bringing to remembrance all that Christ has spoken, thus guarding the believer's heart and mind (John 14:26; Proverbs 4:23). Obedience to God's commandments positions His people above all nations, reflecting the transformative power of submitting one's thoughts and will to Him (Deuteronomy 28:1).
